changes: ON chooses the observation date from the selected overnight window when you change its clock.
CP, High, Low and note clocks use the matching date, including for older sessions.
Out-of-window ON times show the overnight date/time bounds. Saved CP entry still returns to now.
Existing entries and study hours stay intact. No market data is included.
